answer.rationale: Activation messaging (memory_91) demonstrated direct week-one engagement lift and drove meaningful first actions in product. With activation down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ, redeploying this lever addresses the immediate engagement gap without revenue risk. Memory_86 showed onboarding simplification works, but we're already experiencing completion declines despite past gains—suggesting diminishing returns or regression. Memory_91's in-product messaging approach is orthogonal and can compound onboarding improvements. Verification of both ensures we understand current baseline conditions and whether the messaging mechanic still holds. This avoids promotional_pricing (introduces downmarket positioning pressure against our margin structure and qualified revenue goal) and referral_incentive (better suited for healthy retention baseline, not during activation crisis). Enterprise_sales_assist is valuable but won't reverse the SMB activation hemorrhage. A standard_experiment on activation_messaging targets the root metric decline with proven mechanism and preserves optionality for follow-on pricing or referral moves once engagement stabilizes.
